sloka: अमोघं बत मे क्षान्तं पुरुषे पुष्करेक्षणे ।येयमिक्ष्वाकुराज्यश्रीः पुत्र त्वां संश्रयिष्यति ॥२-४-४१॥
transliteration: amoghaṁ bata me kṣāntaṁ puruṣe puṣkarekṣaṇe ।yeyamikṣvākurājyaśrīḥ putra tvāṁ saṁśrayiṣyati ॥2-4-41॥

translations.english: "Lakshmana, rule this earth along with me. This royal fortune has come to you, who are my second self."
